{{Quote|From what you are describing, these don't look like thugs. Either way, they are hauling materials out of the ruins, and that is a crime that we cannot stand idly by and watch. I trust that you can do what I hired you for and take care of these scums.|[[Omkoo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GR" />}}
'''TTLP soldiers''' were the paramilitary forces of the [[Tralus and Talus Liberation Party]],<ref name="SWG:GR" /> a group fighting for the independence of the [[Double Worlds]] from the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SWG:TLP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Talus Liberation Party|Talus}}</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], they were involved in the robbing of [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] graves on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG:GR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer working for the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Omkoo]] fought and killed several TTLP soldiers at an ancient [[Aqualish gravesite]], in the [[Nashal Starport]] and in a [[Weapons Depot|weapons depot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in order to retrieve stolen Aqualish artifacts.<ref name="SWG:GR" />

==Behind the scenes==
TTLP soldiers were a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player characters]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:GR" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> TTLP soldiers were added to the game with the quest "[[W:c:swg:Grave Robbers|Grave Robbers]]" released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
